name: Describable Textures Dataset (DTD)
description: Texture recognition dataset of 5,640 images organized into 47 categories described by human-perceivable attributes.
citation: Cimpoi, M., Maji, S., Kokkinos, I., Mohamed, S., & Vedaldi, A. (2014). Describing Textures in the Wild. Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 3606–3613. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2014.461
